message: `exit 65` exits with 65, the code kapsel uses for its own refusal: a caller cannot tell from the status alone whether the script or kapsel failed
help: pick a status kapsel does not use, e.g. `exit 1` instead of `exit 65`; kapsel's own failures also print `kapsel:` (usage, grants, internal) or an `error[KS-…]` diagnostic (refused) on stderr, and `kapsel check --json` tells a refusal from a plan before anything runs
notes: kapsel exits 64 (usage), 65 (refused), 70 (internal) and 78 (grants) for its own failures; a script that exits with one of them looks like kapsel failed (REQ-KS-014)
